subject: [REQ33] Recommendation: pause req / reclassify role or closeout
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>; Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: [REQ33] Candidate recommendation and proposed offer (Alex Tang)

Hi all,

Following up from the onsite loop last week — attached is Alex Tang's resume and my summary. Alex performed well on system design and the infra-focused take-home; panel feedback is generally positive (strong debugging, distributed systems experience).

Hiring ask: extend offer at band S3 (Senior Engineer) with target total comp of $210k (base $165k + equity + benefits). Current comp band for REQ33 sits S2-S3: midpoint aligns lower than this request.

Questions for the committee:
- Can we approve an offer at the requested band / comp?
- If not, do we close/pause REQ33 and reopen as a Senior IC (S2) OR reclassify to a Manager role that justifies higher band?
- If we pause, can we reallocate headcount to immediate infra needs (SRE req)?

Attachments: resume_alex_tang.pdf; candidate_feedback_notes.docx

Next steps I propose: committee decision by end of week so we can update candidate and the recruiting plan.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Hiring Manager, Compute Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>; Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 14:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: [REQ33] Candidate recommendation and proposed offer (Alex Tang)

Priyom —

Thanks for the summary. A couple quick questions before we escalate to band exceptions:
- How many other candidates at similar level do we have in pipeline for REQ33? (if strong pipeline, we could hold)
- Is this role strictly IC or was there some manager scope the interviewers flagged?
- Can you confirm comp history / current expectations (if disclosed) so compensation can run a quick check?

If Alex requires S3 compensation and the current budget is S2, we should consider the business priority. If this hire materially accelerates a roadmap item, we can justify an exception and document the outcomes we expect. Otherwise pausing and reallocating is reasonable.

Marissa
VP, Talent & Recruiting

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.ai>; Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 10:30:00 +0000
Subject: REQ33 comp band analysis and options

Team —

I ran a quick band analysis (attached comp_band_analysis_req33.xlsx). Key points:
- S2 midpoint: $150k base, S3 midpoint: $180k base. Alex's target of $165k base sits between S2 and S3 (above S2 midpoint but below S3 midpoint).
- Market for infra-focused seniors in NA has shifted up ~8% YoY; to be competitive we'd need to either push to S3 or offer a strong sign-on/equity package.
- Band exception: plausible if the hire is critical or 12-month roadmap impact >= 1.5 FTE equivalent.

Options:
1) Approve an S3 exception and document ROI metrics + 6-month checkpoints.
2) Offer at S2 with higher variable / sign-on and re-run candidate interest (risk of losing candidate).
3) Pause/close REQ33 and reallocate headcount to SRE/infra (we have a pending SRE req with higher immediate impact).

My recommendation: given current infra priority and constrained headcount, pause REQ33 and notify candidate politely. If leadership agrees, we should also instruct recruiting to preserve candidate details for 6 months in case we re-open.

—Karthik
Director, Compensation & Talent Analytics

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.ai>; Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 11:20:00 +0000
Subject: REQ33 recommendation: pause and reallocate

Team —

Thanks for the analysis. After reviewing the comp memo and current product priorities, I'm inclined to pause REQ33. Rationale:
- The infra/SRE backlog has several higher-severity items that will materially reduce customer incident toil; moving headcount there delivers higher short-term ROI.
- REQ33's candidate is strong, but the ask pushes beyond the funded band and would set a precedent for nearby reqs.
- We should avoid band creep unless there's clear product ROI.

Action items if we pause:
- Priyom / Recruiting to send candidate a closeout note and offer to stay engaged (30–60 day follow-up if we re-open).
- Headcount owner to submit a headcount reallocation form to finance (cc: Lauren).
- Recruiting to mark candidate as "warm" and retain resume for 6 months.

If there are objections to pausing, please flag by EOD Monday; otherwise consider this our decision.

Vivek
SVP, Engineering Operations

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Hiring Committee <hiring-committee@redwood.ai>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: REQ33 — formal closeout (no hire) and next steps

Folks —

Per Vivek's note and no objections received, we're proceeding to pause/close REQ33 (no hire). Recording final actions here for audit and recruiting: 

1) Recruiting to send closeout email to candidate (template below) and copy HireLane.
2) Finance/PeopleOps: reallocate headcount to REQ-56 (SRE) starting Q4; Lauren to file the headcount transfer form by EOD tomorrow.
3) Priyom to cancel remaining interviews and update the req status in Greenhouse.
4) Karthik to attach the comp_band_analysis to the req folder for audit.

Candidate closeout template (to be customized):
"Hi Alex — thank you again for interviewing with Redwood Inference. After careful consideration we are pausing this role. We appreciate your time and will keep your information on file for six months should a similar role reopen. If you’d like feedback on interviews, we can share high-level notes"

Attachments to include with the req: comp_band_analysis_req33.xlsx; candidate_feedback_notes.docx

I will send the outgoing candidate note after recruiting prepares the outreach copy. Marking thread as closed.

Thanks for the quick coordination.
Priyom
Hiring Manager, Compute Platform
Redwood Inference
